instruction.name: vfclass.d
instruction.description: Classify each double precision floating point element in `a` according to IEEE 754 `class(x)`, writing the 10-bit classification result into the corresponding element of `dst`.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 2.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: vfclass.d $vr0, $vr8; vfclass.d $vr1, $vr9; vfclass.d $vr2, $vr10; vfclass.d $vr3, $vr11; vfclass.d $vr4, $vr12; vfclass.d $vr5, $vr13; vfclass.d $vr6, $vr14; vfclass.d $vr7, $vr15
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; vreplgr2vr.d $vr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; vreplgr2vr.d $vr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; vreplgr2vr.d $vr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; vreplgr2vr.d $vr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; vreplgr2vr.d $vr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; vreplgr2vr.d $vr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; vreplgr2vr.d $vr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; vreplgr2vr.d $vr15, $r4' --asm 'vfclass.d $vr0, $vr8; vfclass.d $vr1, $vr9; vfclass.d $vr2, $vr10; vfclass.d $vr3, $vr11; vfclass.d $vr4, $vr12; vfclass.d $vr5, $vr13; vfclass.d $vr6, $vr14; vfclass.d $vr7, $vr15'

notes: Latency values are reported as whole cycles; earlier two-decimal values and +/-0.1 bands were rounding artifacts of the measurement pipeline.
